title: Cowboys trade DT Osa Odighizuwa to 49ers for third-round pick

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Cowboys trade DT Odighizuwa to 49ers for pick
sources.description: The Cowboys traded defensive tackle Osa Odighizuwa to the 49ers in exchange for a 2026 third-round draft pick, and defensive tackle Solomon Thomas to the Titans in a seventh-round pick swap.
